functions:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.racing_audit_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
            BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'audit history is append-only'; END $function$

checks.name: ck_application_events_action
checks.sqltext: action::text = ANY (ARRAY['created'::character varying, 'confirmed'::character varying, 'rejected'::character varying, 'cancelled'::character varying]::text[])

checks.name: ck_application_events_status
checks.sqltext: status::text = ANY (ARRAY['awaiting_owner'::character varying, 'awaiting_jockey'::character varying, 'pending_admin'::character varying, 'admin_confirmed'::character varying, 'rejected'::character varying, 'cancelled'::character varying]::text[])

checks.name: ck_applications_consents
checks.sqltext: status::text = 'awaiting_owner'::text AND owner_confirmed_at IS NULL AND jockey_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND initiator_side::text = 'jockey'::text OR status::text = 'awaiting_jockey'::text AND owner_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND jockey_confirmed_at IS NULL AND initiator_side::text = 'owner'::text OR (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['pending_admin'::character varying, 'admin_confirmed'::character varying]::text[])) AND owner_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND jockey_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL OR (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['rejected'::character varying, 'cancelled'::character varying]::text[]))

checks.name: ck_applications_status
checks.sqltext: status::text = ANY (ARRAY['awaiting_owner'::character varying, 'awaiting_jockey'::character varying, 'pending_admin'::character varying, 'admin_confirmed'::character varying, 'rejected'::character varying, 'cancelled'::character varying]::text[])

checks.name: ck_competitions_capacity
checks.sqltext: max_participants IS NULL OR max_participants >= 1 AND max_participants <= 1000

checks.name: ck_competitions_distance
checks.sqltext: distance IS NULL OR distance >= 100 AND distance <= 100000

checks.name: ck_competitions_organizer_email
checks.sqltext: organizer_email IS NULL OR length(organizer_email::text) >= 3 AND length(organizer_email::text) <= 254 AND organizer_email::text = lower(organizer_email::text) AND organizer_email::text ~~ '%@%'::text

checks.name: ck_notifications_source
checks.sqltext: event_id IS NOT NULL AND application_id IS NOT NULL AND audit_id IS NULL OR event_id IS NULL AND audit_id IS NOT NULL

checks.name: ck_predictions_hits
checks.sqltext: podium_hits IS NULL OR podium_hits >= 0 AND podium_hits <= 3

checks.name: ck_users_profile_role
checks.sqltext: role::text = 'OWNER'::text AND owner_id IS NOT NULL AND jockey_id IS NULL OR role::text = 'JOCKEY'::text AND jockey_id IS NOT NULL AND owner_id IS NULL OR (role::text = ANY (ARRAY['ROOT'::character varying, 'ADMIN'::character varying, 'VIEWER'::character varying]::text[])) AND owner_id IS NULL AND jockey_id IS NULL

checks.name: ck_users_role
checks.sqltext: role::text = ANY (ARRAY['ROOT'::character varying, 'ADMIN'::character varying, 'OWNER'::character varying, 'JOCKEY'::character varying, 'VIEWER'::character varying]::text[])

triggers: CREATE TRIGGER audit_logs_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.audit_logs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION racing_audit_immutable()
